about: Public descriptions of the confirmed papers' cards on Estimates (V5.1; the two earlier cards are kept word for word). Keyed by paper_id. year, venue and doi must equal the snapshot and the catalogue (data/replication/paper_catalog_v1.jsonl); frozen_target must equal the target of the paper's frozen primary run; journal_target, where present, must equal the journal cell the snapshot verified. restructure_estimates.validate_descriptions re-checks every entry on each load, and a confirmed paper without an entry stops the build. Version line = venue + year; the card's Target, Outcome / units, Sample and Estimator rows print the text of each language. published_interval_note is appended to the published interval and exists exactly when the published interval is calculated from a reported SE. note is kept for the record and is not printed. sources are paths under data/replication/.

shover2019-e698786e.venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences 116(26):12624-12626

en.target: Table 1, third column, medical cannabis law
en.outcome: Age-adjusted opioid overdose mortality; percent difference from a log-outcome model
en.note: The paper prints a 95% interval but no SE; the interval method is not verified.

en.target: Table 3, panel B (Selective), column (5), college entrance exam mandate; REStat p. 679
en.outcome: First-time freshmen enrollment at selective colleges, by state of residence; log points
en.sample: ACT states except Michigan, even years 1994–2008; 24 states, 192 state-years; mandate in force from 2002 in Colorado and Illinois
en.estimator: Unweighted OLS; state-clustered SE; state and year effects; control for log overall enrollment
en.note: The journal table prints the SE (0.017); the published interval is the point estimate plus or minus 1.96 SE. The second AI agent's interval uses the t distribution with 23 degrees of freedom. The frozen target is the working-paper cell, Table 6a panel B column (5) (SE 0.018), which the journal prints as Table 3 panel B column (5).

zh.target: 表 3，B 栏（选拔性院校），第 (5) 列，大学入学考试强制要求；期刊第 679 页
zh.outcome: 选拔性院校新生入学人数（按学生居住州）；对数点
zh.sample: 除密歇根州外的 ACT 州，1994–2008 年的偶数年；24 个州、192 个州年观测；科罗拉多州和伊利诺伊州自 2002 年起实施该要求
zh.estimator: 非加权普通最小二乘；标准误按州聚类；控制州效应、年份效应及总入学人数的对数
zh.published_interval_note: 根据报告的标准误计算
zh.note: 期刊表格印有标准误 (0.017)；发表值区间为点估计加减 1.96 倍标准误。第二个 AI 智能体的区间使用自由度为 23 的 t 分布。冻结目标是工作论文表 6a B 栏第 (5) 列（标准误 0.018），期刊中对应表 3 B 栏第 (5) 列。
